# Left and right margins: DECLRMM and DECSLRM. Most cases start from a 5x5
# screen of the letters a..y, row by row.

=== CSI s without DECLRMM saves the cursor
source: xterm ctlseqs (SCOSC when DECLRMM is reset)
size: 5x5
input: \e[3;3H\e[2;4s\e[H\e[u
cursor: 3,3

=== DECSLRM homes the cursor
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSLRM
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[3;3H\e[2;4s
cursor: 1,1

=== SU scrolls only between the left and right margins
source: esctest2 su.py test_SU_RespectsLeftRightScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;3H\e[2S
screen:
|almne|
|fqrsj|
|kvwxo|
|p...t|
|u...y|

=== SD scrolls only between the left and right margins
source: esctest2 sd.py test_SD_RespectsLeftRightScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[T
screen:
|a...e|
|fbcdj|
|kghio|
|plmnt|
|uqrsy|

=== DL acts only between the left and right margins
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_InLeftRightScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;3H\e[M
cursor: 2,2
screen:
|abcde|
|flmnj|
|kqrso|
|pvwxt|
|u...y|

=== DL outside the left and right margins does nothing
source: esctest2 dl.py test_DL_OutsideLeftRightScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;5H\e[M
screen:
|abcde|
|fghij|
|klmno|
|pqrst|
|uvwxy|

=== IL acts only between the left and right margins
source: esctest2 il.py test_IL_RespectsScrollRegion (with DECSLRM)
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;3H\e[L
screen:
|abcde|
|f...j|
|kghio|
|plmnt|
|uqrsy|

=== ICH stops at the right margin
source: esctest2 ich.py test_ICH_ScrollOffRightMarginInScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: abcde\e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;2H\e[@
screen:
|a.bce|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|

=== DCH pulls in from the right margin
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_RespectsMargins
size: 5x5
input: abcde\e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;2H\e[P
screen:
|acd.e|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|

=== DCH outside the left and right margins does nothing
source: esctest2 dch.py test_DCH_DoesNothingOutsideLeftRightMargin
size: 5x5
input: abcde\e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;5H\e[P
screen:
|abcde|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|

=== Printing wraps from the right margin to the left margin
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECAWM_OnRespectsLeftRightMargin
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;2HXYZW
cursor: 2,3
screen:
|.XYZ.|
|.W...|
|.....|
|.....|
|.....|

=== CR goes to the left margin
source: esctest2 cr.py test_CR_MovesToLeftMarginWhenRightOfLeftMargin
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;3H\r
cursor: 1,2

=== CR left of the left margin goes to column one
source: esctest2 cr.py test_CR_MovesToLeftOfScreenWhenLeftOfLeftMargin
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[3;4s\e[1;2H\r
cursor: 1,1

=== CUF stops at the right margin
source: esctest2 cuf.py test_CUF_StopsAtRightMarginInScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;2H\e[9C
cursor: 1,4

=== CUB stops at the left margin
source: esctest2 cub.py test_CUB_StopsAtLeftMarginInScrollRegion
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[1;4H\e[9D
cursor: 1,2

=== Resetting DECLRMM removes the margins
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECLRMM
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[?69l\e[1;2H\e[9C
cursor: 1,5

=== CUP in origin mode is relative to all four margins
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_RespectsOriginMode
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[1;1H
cursor: 2,2

=== CUP in origin mode clamps to all four margins
source: xterm ctlseqs DECOM
size: 5x5
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[9;9H
cursor: 4,4

=== IND outside the left and right margins does not scroll
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_MovesDoesNotScrollOutsideLeftRight
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[5;5H\eD
cursor: 5,5
screen:
|abcde|
|fghij|
|klmno|
|pqrst|
|uvwxy|

=== IND inside the left and right margins scrolls only between them
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_Scrolls (with DECSLRM)
size: 5x5
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[5;3H\eD
cursor: 5,3
screen:
|aghie|
|flmnj|
|kqrso|
|pvwxt|
|u...y|

=== Scrolling inside left and right margins keeps the scrollback empty
source: DEC STD 070 (no whole line leaves the screen)
size: 5x5
scrollback: 10
input: abcde\r\nfghij\r\nklmno\r\npqrst\r\nuvwxy
input: \e[?69h\e[2;4s\e[3S
history: 0
